sections.html: This archer fish that lives exclusively in freshwater originates from Burma.

The animals of the current importation have a very uniform pattern; this is quite different to the specimens observed in former importations. Possibly the fish in the current import represent even a species new to science, for there are a lot of hints that the real diversity and species-richness in archerfish is not understood yet. Currently only 7 species are recognized in the genus Toxotes.
